items.question: What number of repetitions and what exclusive substance are prescribed for reciting the mantra?
premises: The instruction prescribes reciting the mantra.
The prescribed quantity is six hundred-thousand repetitions.
The recitation is to be performed with ghee alone.
items.inference: The mantra should be recited six hundred-thousand times using only ghee.
items.plain_english: One should recite the mantra six hundred thousand times with only ghee.
